_doc: Batches of one material compared by examples/batch_comparison.py (issue #71). The unit is a workbook (material ID). Tests by different author groups are different batches, except Santus 2018 and Benedetti 2022 (one batch, decision d101). 'constants' maps a batch to a published-constants record (Calibrations/) used on its own run and when it is the design batch of a transfer. 'fabest_benchmark': true adds the scatter between the series of the FABEST source file (one material batch, d105) as the test-series yardstick.

42CrMo4.notes: 42CrMo4 +QT. 42CrMo4_QT: Santus 2018 and Benedetti 2022, one material batch, two test series (d101, d105); 42CrMo4_Reis: Anes/Reis 2014; 42CrMo4_FABEST: FABEST PBS series. SSF runs only with the surface published for the Reis batch: in sample on Reis, out of sample when Reis is the design batch.

Ti6Al4V.notes: Ti6Al4V: Meneghetti 2018 failures (10) and Delahay 2006 run-outs (4), two author groups; the Summary averages the properties of both (Su 1035 = (980 + 1090)/2, Sigm1 576 = (500 + 652)/2; issue #24). Ti6Al4V_Berto: Berto 2015 (48 failures). All assessed tests are torsional.
